name: Saltwater Savages
summary: A port keeper asks you to thin the Murlocs along Eastwind Shore. The nuisance has become a constant complaint from sailors, fishermen, and his children.

sections.title: Complaints at the Port
sections.body: The port keeper has heard enough complaints from sailors, fishermen, and even his children. Murlocs trouble him, but he still has a port to run. He asks you to kill some along Eastwind Shore, hoping for a little peace from the noise around him.

faq.q: Why does the port keeper want the Murlocs killed?
faq.answer: Sailors, fishermen, and the port keeper's children keep complaining about them. He calls them a nuisance and wants some peace while he runs the port.

faq.q: Which Murlocs is he asking about?
faq.answer: He asks you to kill Murloc Oracles and Murloc Warriors along Eastwind Shore.
The port keeper points you to Eastwind Shore.

faq.q: Does killing these Murlocs solve the problem?
faq.answer: The port keeper expects more Murlocs to return soon, though he hopes their deaths will give him some peace until then.
